run_stable_softmax: run stable_softmax on JAX logits to get numerically stable softmax output for bfloat16
create_bfloat16_context: create a bfloat16 context manager that stores variables in float32 and casts on retrieval
test_mask_mean: test mask_mean to compute a masked average of JAX arrays along specified axes
build_batched_gather: build a batched gather operation using JAX vmap equivalent to tf.gather with batch dims
run_ks_normal_test: run ks_normal_test to perform a Kolmogorov-Smirnov normality test on sample data
